subject: 'Error: Failed to create the shared library' after updating to Catalina on MacOS

messages.author: 403a8738ba91e2e5
messages.subject: 'Error: Failed to create the shared library' after updating to Catalina on MacOS
parts:
Hi all,

I was trying to run some code, and got the following error when using compileNimble(): "Error : Failed to create the shared library.". This code was working like a charm on my Mac before I updated to Catalina. 

Using the 'showCompilerOutput = TRUE’ option produced more details which didn’t help though. 

Fortunately for me, Daniel Turek who’s on sabbatical with us in Montpellier had a look and found these: 

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/58313047/cannot-compile-r-packages-with-c-code-after-updating-to-macos-catalina

https://thecoatlessprofessor.com/programming/cpp/r-compiler-tools-for-rcpp-on-macos/

To fix the issue, I had to simply run the following command from the OSX Terminal application and restart my laptop: 

$ xcode-select --install

I thought I’d share my experience in case other Nimble users run into the same troubles. 

Cheers, and thank you Daniel. Back to my Nimble experiments I guess :-) Thanks to the whole team for such an amazing work! 

Olivier
